vestigium:
[DEFINE_WORKER: "Computes the trace of an n x n matrix, sorts rows and transposed rows to count adjacent equal pairs, and prints a formatted Case #1 result line whose reported values depend on whether those counts are zero." vestigium]
    [INPUTS]
        <REF> a </REF>: int[][] "The n x n integer matrix to analyze."
        <REF> n </REF>: int "The dimension of matrix a; rows and columns are indexed from 0 to n-1."
    [END_INPUTS]

    [OUTPUTS]
    [END_OUTPUTS]

    [MAIN_FLOW]
        [SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
            [COMMAND Initialize k, r, and c to 0, and allocate a new n x n integer matrix b with all elements initialized to 0. RESULT initial_state]
            [COMMAND For i from 0 to n-1 inclusive, add a[i][i] to k in order to compute the trace of a. RESULT k]
            [COMMAND For each i from 0 to n-1 inclusive and each j from 0 to n-1 inclusive, set b[i][j] = a[j][i] to copy the transpose of a into b. RESULT b]
            [COMMAND For each i from 0 to n-1 inclusive, sort the row a[i] in ascending order using Arrays.sort(a[i]). RESULT a]
            [COMMAND Initialize repeat to 0 and count to 0. RESULT repeat_count_initial]
            [COMMAND For each row i from 0 to n-1 inclusive, scan j starting at 0 while j < n-1: if a[i][j] equals a[i][j+1], increment repeat; after each comparison set count to Math.max(count, repeat); after finishing that row's j loop, if repeat is greater than 0, reset repeat to 0. RESULT count]
            [COMMAND For each i from 0 to n-1 inclusive, sort the row b[i] in ascending order using Arrays.sort(b[i]). RESULT b]
            [COMMAND Initialize count1 to 0 and repeat1 to 0. RESULT repeat1_count1_initial]
            [COMMAND For each row i from 0 to n-1 inclusive, scan j starting at 0 while j < n-1: if b[i][j] equals b[i][j+1], increment repeat1; after each comparison set count1 to Math.max(count1, repeat1); after finishing that row's j loop, if repeat1 is greater than 0, reset repeat1 to 0. RESULT count1]
            [COMMAND Set r = count + 1, c = count1 + 1, and counter = 1. RESULT r_c_counter]
            [COMMAND Evaluate the four mutually exclusive zero/nonzero combinations of count and count1 and execute the matching output branch. RESULT output_dispatch]
        [END_SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
    [END_MAIN_FLOW]

    [ALTERNATIVE_FLOW: count1 == 0 and count == 0]
        [SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
            [COMMAND Print the string produced by concatenating 'Case #', counter, ': ', a space, k, a space, count, a space, and count1. RESULT printed_line]
            [COMMAND Increment counter by 1. RESULT counter]
        [END_SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
    [END_ALTERNATIVE_FLOW]

    [ALTERNATIVE_FLOW: count1 != 0 and count != 0]
        [SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
            [COMMAND Print the string produced by concatenating 'Case #', counter, ': ', a space, k, a space, r, a space, and c. RESULT printed_line]
            [COMMAND Increment counter by 1. RESULT counter]
        [END_SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
    [END_ALTERNATIVE_FLOW]

    [ALTERNATIVE_FLOW: count1 == 0 and count != 0]
        [SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
            [COMMAND Print the string produced by concatenating 'Case #', counter, ': ', a space, k, a space, r, a space, and count1. RESULT printed_line]
            [COMMAND Increment counter by 1. RESULT counter]
        [END_SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
    [END_ALTERNATIVE_FLOW]

    [ALTERNATIVE_FLOW: count1 != 0 and count == 0]
        [SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
            [COMMAND Print the string produced by concatenating 'Case #', counter, ': ', a space, k, a space, count, a space, and c. RESULT printed_line]
            [COMMAND Increment counter by 1. RESULT counter]
        [END_SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
    [END_ALTERNATIVE_FLOW]

[END_WORKER]
